js: map.jumpTo({center:[101.6,14.3],zoom:11});await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500));document.querySelector('#bMs').click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500));const c=map.getCanvas().getBoundingClientRect();const pts=[[600,300],[850,280],[900,520],[640,560]];for(const [x,y] of pts){const ll=map.unproject([x,y]);map.fire('click',{lngLat:ll,point:{x,y},originalEvent:new MouseEvent('click')});await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300))}const l=map.unproject([600,300]);map.fire('click',{lngLat:l,point:{x:600,y:300},originalEvent:new MouseEvent('click')})
